solverOptions.patch: one-byte pinned-binary equivalent of original C -n flag

projection: Equal-area solver plane; shared uniform affine normalization; target latitude encodes solver Y through inverse Mercator atan(sinh(Y)) so flat rendering preserves planar population areas

sources.populationBasis: UN World Population Prospects 2024, historical population for 2023

quality.areaErrorReference: Final rounded Mercator-decoded solver-plane geometry, normalized by total known-population area

limitations: Population area ratios are preserved in the flat Mercator display plane; lens/globe views reproject that plane and do not preserve exact screen-area ratios.
Unknown-population territories, including Antarctica, use explicit background-area solver weights; these are not population estimates.
Tiny territories may exceed the solver area-error tolerance; see per-feature areaError.
